'''2021 Retro Event''' (PDS2) was the Players Committee Premiere–Death Star II constructed event on GEMP, May 2021. [[Bastian Winkelhaus]] finished 1st in the published Top 8.<ref name="pc">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2021-retro-event-top-8-pds2/ 2021-05 Retro Event (Top 8 – PDS2)], starwarsccg.org. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261016153822/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2021-retro-event-top-8-pds2.html Internet Archive]</ref> Entry was free. The ten-game Qualifying Term ran from 1 April to 10 May 2021, followed by the Match-Play Term for the top eight from 12 May; 40 players had registered by 22 February 2021.<ref name="retro21-announce">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2021-retro-event-pds2-coming-soon/ 2021 Retro Event (PDS2) Coming Soon!], Jared Napolitano, starwarsccg.org (22 February 2021). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210302045505/https://www.starwarsccg.org/2021-retro-event-pds2-coming-soon/ Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="dc-807321683643465760">"Starts April 1st, it's free, there will be really sweet prizes.", JaredNap in #general, SWCCG Players Committee Discord (5 February 2021). [https://discord.com/channels/401469156907679746/401469473628094465/807321683643465760 Discord message]</ref><ref name="dc-813494720520257556">"Registration has been open for a few weeks & is already at 40 players", JaredNap in #general, SWCCG Players Committee Discord (22 February 2021). [https://discord.com/channels/401469156907679746/401469473628094465/813494720520257556 Discord message]</ref> Ninety-eight players played at least one game, and sixty played the maximum of ten.<ref name="retro21-top8">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/retro-event-qualifying-term-wraps-top-8-to-start-soon/ Retro Event Qualifying Term wraps; Top 8 to start soon], starwarsccg.org (11 May 2021). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210511012657/https://www.starwarsccg.org/retro-event-qualifying-term-wraps-top-8-to-start-soon/ Internet Archive]</ref> [[Chris Gogolen]] commentated the first quarterfinal, [[Joe Olson]] against [[Koen Meijssen]], on 16 May 2021,<ref name="dc-843449846396616716">"Chris Gogolen will cover the first quarterfinal match between Joe Olson & Koen Meijssen", JaredNap in #cantina, SWCCG Players Committee Discord (16 May 2021). [https://discord.com/channels/401469156907679746/401469157587025922/843449846396616716 Discord message]</ref> and the second game between [[Andrew Bethell]] and [[Hayes Hunter]] decided the last place in the semifinals.<ref name="retro21-top8" /><ref name="dc-845045042099781703">"COTVG v Hayes game 2 will decide the last spot in the top four.", Solidsnack3 in #cantina, SWCCG Players Committee Discord (20 May 2021). [https://discord.com/channels/401469156907679746/401469157587025922/845045042099781703 Discord message]</ref>
